correctness.rationale: Pinned RESULT.md reduces the STFT localization operator by frequency Plancherel to multiplication by m(t)=pi^{-1/2}int_E exp(-(t-y)^2)dy. Its derivative is (2exp(-t^2)/sqrt(pi))[exp(-a^2)sinh(2at)-exp(-b^2)sinh(2bt)]. x coth(x) strictly increasing makes sinh(2bt)/sinh(2at) monotone for t>0, giving a unique threshold and no other extrema. At the threshold q=ae^{-a²}-be^{-b²}=0, the derivative cubic coefficient is -8c(b²-a²)/(3sqrt(pi)), hence m(0)-m(t)=2c(b²-a²)t^4/(3sqrt(pi))+O(t^6). The IFT at t²=0 proves square-root peak splitting and quadratic norm gain. Near noncritical simple peaks Taylor gives s^{1/2}; nonconstant analytic finite-monotone-branch m gives only absolutely continuous multiplication spectrum [0,M], no eigenvalues. Independently evaluated nine critical fourth-order ratios for three widths, including w=1, a_c=0.271702319209... . The smooth-spectral expansion is not inferred from those finite tests.
